schedule.name: 信息发现
schedule.input: Product / Competitor Sample Intelligence, Multi-Agent Engineering & Mechanism Intelligence, and Published Research & Industry Application Intelligence.
schedule.work: Execute the three intelligence profiles plus the theme-first sample overlay; normalize and deduplicate current, rolling-window and prior-art evidence by research problem.

schedule.name: 分类选题
schedule.work: Make one Selected or No Selection decision for each of the three research columns.

schedule.name: 深度阅读
schedule.input: Selected objects in Today's Research Plan
schedule.work: Perform source-complete Deep Reading and evidence extraction.

schedule.name: 研究分析
schedule.work: State the research question, classify evidence identities, analyze and compare, form a bounded judgment, identify an article type and dynamic modules, map general implications, then test optional first-party relevance.

schedule.name: 内容生产与正式题图
schedule.work: Build complete bilingual V2 candidates and final article-specific editorial raster covers in the 15:00 Production stage. Read the full article, generate and inspect each final cover including its thumbnail, persist generation and review evidence, then pass all editorial, visual and layout gates. A placeholder or deterministic baseline does not satisfy final cover acceptance. There is no separate 16:00 cover task.

schedule.name: 成果发布
schedule.work: Validate complete same-date candidates and authorize Public Outbox packages; never write or push the publication repository.

schedule.name: 每周综合与 P2 检查
schedule.name_zh: 每周综合与 P2 检查
schedule.input: local authoritative P2 Registry and checkpoints plus evidence-validated Daily Research from the previous seven days
schedule.work: Check every due P2 object, execute at most one triggered P2 special study, and produce an independently readable AI Research Brief about material weekly changes, connections, evidence, disputes, judgments and open questions.
schedule.output: P2 Check Record, zero or one P2 Special Study, and Weekly Synthesis

schedule.name: 学术观察
schedule.input: Paper, benchmark, specification or institution objects
schedule.work: Execute the complete reading, analysis, writing, evidence and editing pipeline.

schedule.name: 长期项目研究
schedule.input: Independent queues for TMPA, FCoP, CodeFlowMu, Digital Employee and Research Operating System
schedule.work: Advance eligible program objects through Program Queue, Research, Review and Program Publication.
schedule.output: Program Runtime Record and governed program transition
